surface.$description: Under the frost. Life Hub cards are glass, so nothing solid.

frost.$description: Light mode glass: a frosted fill, brightest toward the sun (top right). Dashboard by default.

backdrop.$description: Blurs the marble behind the frost.

frost-feather.$description: Soft edge where the frost fades, so a thin clear band of glass shows at the rim.

rim.$description: One sun in the header, top right: the rim is brightest facing it, with a faint glint where light leaves (bottom left).

shadow.$description: Cast and contact shadow away from the sun, a bevel glow on the sunlit edges and a faint shade on the far ones.
